painpoints.text: Salvage retrieval is structurally degraded for loop runs: `fabro dump --server https://mirtuell.net <run-id>` answers 'Authentication required' in the implementer sandbox (fabro auth status: not logged in; run 01M4Y0050VYNWA9EBNBKFZVBNE, this pass). The salvage seed's only retrieval path assumes credentials the run shell does not carry. Fix idea: let the engine inject a scoped read token for the loop's own server into run shells (mirroring the GITHUB_TOKEN injection in resolve_workflow_env), or attach the conclusion diff patch to the salvage seed body so retrieval never needs server auth.

Red-proofing a lint check by planting a literal in a real tree file and restoring with `git checkout --` also silently reverted a legitimate earlier edit in the same file (select.md, this run): the restore goes back to HEAD, not to the pre-plant working state. Fix idea: red-proof against a scratch copy under mktemp -d (lint accepts file content via the checked tree only, so instead plant in a file with NO other pending edits), or restore with `git stash`-free surgical removal of just the planted line.
